tieu_de: Intern AI / Python Engineering  Japanese at least N4
mo_ta_cong_viec:
Write clean, readable, and maintainable Python code to build scripts, REST APIs, and data processing utilities.
Assist in integrating AI/ML models and services (e.g., OpenAI API, Hugging Face, LangChain, or custom models) into existing applications and microservices.
Help build, test, and optimize data extraction, transformation, and ingestion pipelines (ETL/ELT) for AI workflows.
Write unit and integration tests (using pytest or similar) to ensure the reliability and performance of AI features and data feeds.
Conduct fast-paced research and experiments with open-source AI tools, libraries, and prompt engineering strategies to solve specific technical problems.
Participate in agile team ceremonies (standups, code reviews) and maintain clear technical documentation for tools and APIs developed during the internship.
yeu_cau:
Currently pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor’s in Computer Science, Data Science, Software Engineering, or a related quantitative field.
Strong foundation in core Python programming (data structures, OOP, file handling, async concepts, standard libraries).
Practical coursework or project experience with machine learning concepts, NLP, or modern AI tools (e.g., NumPy, Pandas, Scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow, or LLM APIs).
Basic understanding of building or consuming RESTful APIs using frameworks like FastAPI or Flask.
Familiarity with Git and GitHub/GitLab for code versioning and pull requests.
Strong analytical skills, curiosity about emerging AI technologies, and a self-driven willingness to learn.
Japanese at least N4
Nice-to-Haves (Bonus)
Experience with Apache Kafka, LlamaIndex, Ollama, and sensors.
Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and managing multi-database container setups.
Knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and CI/CD pipelines.
Understanding of system profiling, profiling memory leaks in Python, and API benchmarking.
